value.title: Phase A: secured issuer, socket, ownership, clients and counting (count-only)
Inventory: LOW notes and operation classes
value.success: Squirrel's three LOW notes fixed; every seat-authority entry lists its operation classes; the sensor checks operations include the class and an implicit HEAD carries its GET's classification.

value.title: The secured issuer
value.success: Migration 0045 (seat_nonces, seat_capabilities); a nonce through a 0600 file; issuance in one store transaction only on a nonce, the peer path or the current token; public facts get no token and no context grant; two-phase rotation; every tombstone revokes; digests rebuild after a restart.

value.title: The socket, peer credentials and the boundary walk
value.success: daemon.sock (0600) on the same router; peer read at accept; a fresh in-process walk of at most 16 hops to the nearest boundary, no cache, the H->M->S->P regression; the boundary index capped at 4,096.

value.title: One owned session
value.success: A boundary hosting two or more live sessions proves nothing tokenless, with the ruled E-RS-SEAT-AMBIGUOUS text; ownership moves only by token or after the owner is observed dead.

value.title: Secret handling
value.success: Tokens only in the owner's memory and its registration response; never in env, argv, /health, roster, cards or spine; the nonce file is 0600 and unlinked on read; the remote listener refuses capability-bearing requests; a probe failure counts as neither.

value.title: Every client presents the capability (A2)
value.success: Phase A2, stacked on A1: Copilot, OMP and Pi send the token over the socket; the shim, pij-rs and hooks act through peer credentials.

value.title: Counting by operation
value.success: /health capabilities: 8 classes x token, peer, neither, plus nonce first registrations, counted by operation (argv leaf, implicit HEAD with its GET); nothing refused.

value.title: Cost
value.success: No new launch; a tokenless walk measured at about 23 us; live before-and-after readings at the A1 plus A2 deploy.

value.title: Docs and states
value.success: The Seat authority section, the refusal table and enforcement state, F88's ledger row, the skill's no-/new rule; checked with the verdicts.
